## Completed — 2026-10-03

Workflow commit1a2ce256cf integrated as next4b0899328f; source progress d82d40cc7e integrated as nexta48029fa50; canonical checkpoint e3da03bfa1 integrated as nextd819a5499a. A fresh agent verified the handoff and its two corrections: #327 frame/docs stays in P3 and the VM runner help names the correct executable/cases. Five changed skills validate, every local link resolves, and rules/register/index/ceremony checks pass. D-WORKFLOW-140 records the continuation rule. The live milestone was read back with M7.P1 current and P2→P3→P4→P5 unchanged.

Delivery resumed:12 invalid-marker controls and9 final retry controls fail on the old scripts and pass after. The complete host suite passes1,367 checks plus93 focused cases; both #320 settings race controls fail before and all10 cases/119 assertions pass after. No branded candidate exists yet. The remaining current action is actor/predecessor mapping and guest-case promotion, then P2 release inputs. Receipts and the fresh-agent handoff proof: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-03-m7-p1/.

The maintainer requested:

> Perfect. If there are other changes we need to make to instruction files within the project around the process we use and how we go about naming and continuing work streams, let's make sure we do that. Beyond that, if we feel good with milestone 7, let's focus on that so we can get our first new build out under the new project name.

M7's ordered body and phase naming are established by #388. Three delivery skills still link to absent serial-execution and GitHub-delivery rule files; the resume skill ends with a mandatory menu even when continuation is already requested and authorized. Repair these references using this fork's existing law, make resume consume the live milestone queue, and continue M7.P1 under #356/#365/#320. Do not import another project's Forgejo or branch workflow.

Can this be done on the VM? No — these are host instruction/tracker checks, with no device-dependent behavior. Product migration qualification remains VM-first under #356/#365.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Changed delivery references resolve to this repository's canonical rules; link inspection and rules-check output retained.
- [x] Resume/stash instructions reconcile canonical next, live milestone priorities and existing authorization, without a redundant continuation prompt; reviewed instruction diff retained.
- [x] Milestone body and canonical handoff show the current M7.P1 regression work and next action; GitHub readback retained.
- [x] A failing production-script migration regression is recorded under #356/#365, demonstrating that delivery has resumed.
title: M7.P0: Align delivery and resume instructions with the milestone workflow
